transcript:
Speaker A: तेरे सर्टिफिकेट पे शर्मा लिखा है तो काम आसान होगा? नहीं। यहाँ तेरा सरनेम काम नहीं आएगा। लाइन में लगना पड़ेगा, वो भी पीछे। [If 'Sharma' is written on your certificate, will your work be easy? No. Your surname won't work here. You'll have to stand in line, and that too at the back.]
Speaker B: सर, मैं तीन दिन से आ रहा हूँ। बस एक स्टैम्प चाहिए। [Sir, I've been coming for three days. I just need one stamp.]
Speaker A: तीन दिन और आ। हमने ३०० साल वेट किया, तू तीन दिन नहीं कर सकता? [Come for three more days. We waited for 300 years, can't you wait for three days?]
Speaker B: Sir, may I say something?
Speaker A: इंग्लिश? तू इंग्लिश बोल रहा है? [English? You are speaking English?]
Speaker B: Yes, sir. Because I want you to listen. Not as a Sharma, not as an upper caste, as a citizen standing at your counter for three days.
Speaker A: अरे देखो, इंग्लिश भी आती है शर्मा को। [Oh look, the Sharma also knows English.]
Speaker B: Sir, you are in power today, that is a good thing. You earned it, your community fought for it, I respect that. But what you are doing right now, delaying my file because of my surname, this is the same thing that was done to your people. You hated it then, why are you doing it now?
Speaker A: तू मुझे सिखाएगा? [Will you teach me?]
Speaker B: I'm not teaching you, sir. I'm requesting you. Discrimination does not become right when the direction changes. Wrong is wrong, no matter who does it. आपके पास पावर है, use it to be fair, not to take revenge on someone who never did anything to you. [You have power, use it to be fair, not to take revenge on someone who never did anything to you.] Sir, I come from a family that had nothing. My father drove an auto. शर्मा सरनेम से कुछ नहीं मिला हमें। [We got nothing from the Sharma surname.] I learned English on my own. इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप से, जनरल इंग्लिश शो से, एआई कोच से। पांच बार गलत बोला, पांच सौ बार सुधारा। [From English Seekho app, General English Show, AI Coach. Spoke wrong five times, corrected it five hundred times.] मैंने इंग्लिश इसलिए सीखी क्योंकि मुझे पता था एक दिन मुझे अपनी बात रखनी पड़ेगी और आज वो दिन है। Please stamp my file, sir. I have been waiting.
Speaker A: फाइल दे यहाँ। [Give me the file.]
Speaker B: Thank you, sir. और सर, आपके बेटे को भी इंग्लिश सिखाओ। पावर हमेशा नहीं रहती, स्किल रहती है। इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करवा दो उन्हें। जनरल इंग्लिश शो खोल दो। एक महीने में फर्क दिखेगा। पावर से इज्जत नहीं मिलती सर, बोलने से मिलती है। [And sir, teach your son English too. Power doesn't last forever, skill does. Get them to download the English Seekho app. Open the General English Show. You'll see a difference in a month. Respect is not gained by power, sir, it is gained by speaking.]
Speaker C: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: A dramatic skit shows a citizen overcoming bureaucratic discrimination by speaking up in fluent English. He credits his language skills to the English Seekho app, prompting the officer to sign his file. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app.
